description:
Pay {2} to Mirage Mirror to have it become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0}.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh, returning Rograkh to the command zone.
When Rograkh enters the command zone, both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
